hero.h1: Carpet Cleaning Marketing Built on Repeat Customers
hero.subhead: For carpet cleaning companies doing $500,000 to $600,000 a year. ASP runs paid ads, SEO and follow-up with past customers, all built to keep every crew booked.

why.heading: Your customer list is the asset
why.intro: The Carpet and Rug Institute (CRI) recommends professional cleaning every 12 to 18 months for both homes and businesses. That gives you a natural reminder schedule after every job.

cards.title: Credit repeats to follow-up
cards.body: The first job belongs to the channel that found the customer. Repeat cleanings get credited to your follow-up, so ad results don't look better than they are.

cards.title: Catch customers who stopped booking
cards.body: Splitting new and repeat jobs shows which past customers have gone quiet, so a win-back message can reach them.

cards.title: Show the credentials buyers ask about
cards.body: CRI's hiring guidance suggests asking whether technicians are IICRC certified and how long the company has been in business. Put both answers on your site and ads.

services.heading: What ASP runs for carpet cleaning companies
services.intro: Ads and search win the first job. Follow-up built on your job data wins the next one.

cards.title: Local Services Ads
cards.body: Carpet cleaning services is a US Local Services Ads category where Google runs it. With several crews finishing jobs, a review request after each one keeps your profile growing.

cards.title: Google Search Ads
cards.body: Search campaigns for the homeowner dealing with a stain or a move-out today, split by service so you can see which one pays.

cards.title: Carpet cleaning SEO
cards.body: Separate pages for the services buyers search for, such as carpet, upholstery, rugs and commercial maintenance.

cards.title: Business Profile and citations
cards.body: Your Google Business Profile kept current in every area your crews cover. We also clean up your listings on other sites and handle review requests.

cards.title: Facebook and Instagram
cards.body: Seasonal offers aimed at past customers and the neighborhoods you already serve, built from your own customer lists.

cards.title: Repeat-customer follow-up
cards.body: Rebooking reminders, win-back messages and review requests. If you run Housecall Pro, we build them on its job events, so each one is triggered by real work.

process.heading: How we start with a carpet cleaning company

steps.title: Begin with the Diagnostic
steps.body: Spend about 90 seconds online and get a read on where your marketing stands before anyone sells you anything.

steps.title: Split new from repeat
steps.body: We separate first jobs from repeat cleanings, so each ad channel and your follow-up get their own credit.

steps.title: Turn on follow-up

pricing.heading: Packages for carpet cleaning companies
pricing.subhead: Organic SEO is part of every package, starting with Foundation. Growth is where ASP takes over your Google, Local Services and Meta ad management.

faqs.question: How often should we remind customers to book again?
faqs.answer: CRI recommends professional cleaning every 12 to 18 months for homes and businesses. That is a sensible starting point for reminder timing. Your own repeat-booking data should then set the final schedule.

faqs.question: Can a company with several locations run Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, where Google offers the category. If two of your locations serve the same area, Google shows only your highest-ranking ad there. So map each location's coverage first.

faqs.question: Do you market commercial carpet cleaning?
faqs.answer: Yes. We write commercial pages and ads for facility buyers. They name the standards your crews follow, such as CRI 204 for commercial maintenance and ANSI/IICRC S100 for cleaning procedures.

faqs.question: Do you work with Housecall Pro?
faqs.answer: Yes. ASP is a Housecall Pro Affiliate, and Housecall Pro lists carpet cleaning among its industries. We build rebooking reminders, win-back messages and review requests on HCP's job events.

faqs.question: What does ASP cost for a carpet cleaning company?
faqs.answer: ASP sells whole packages; the pricing cards above show what each one includes. Ad spend is paid from your own accounts straight to Google and Meta.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for carpet cleaning companies?
faqs.answer: They fit carpet cleaning well. It's a lower-ticket service people buy again, so a seasonal offer can sell directly to past customers and to the neighborhoods you already serve.

faqs.question: Who owns our customer list if we leave ASP?
faqs.answer: You do. In a repeat business, the customer list pays you again and again, so it stays yours. So do your website, Business Profile and reviews, ad accounts and the follow-up automations we build, with no exit fee to move any of it.

cta.heading: Book more repeat cleanings
cta.body: Start with a 30-minute audit call. We'll look at your ads, site and follow-up, then show you what to fix first.
